labels.name: Osteoclast
labels.function: Resorbs bone; outpaces formation in osteoporosis

labels.name: Osteoblast
labels.function: Forms bone; suppressed by glucocorticoids

labels.name: Osteoid
labels.function: Unmineralized matrix; stays soft with low vitamin D

labels.name: Mineralized bone matrix
labels.function: Calcium/phosphate-to-collagen ratio is normal in osteoporosis

labels.name: Bisphosphonate
labels.function: First line; take upright with water; jaw osteonecrosis risk

labels.name: Denosumab
labels.function: Anti-RANKL antibody; rebound fractures if stopped abruptly

labels.name: Teriparatide
labels.function: Intermittent PTH analog that stimulates bone formation

labels.name: Romosozumab
labels.function: Anti-sclerostin antibody; at most 12 monthly doses

labels.name: Raloxifene
labels.function: SERM that lowers vertebral fractures; raises VTE risk

labels.name: Lytic stage
labels.function: Highly active resorption dominates

labels.name: Mixed stage
labels.function: Bone is broken down and built at the same time

labels.name: Sclerotic stage
labels.function: Formation predominates to make up for lost bone

labels.name: Quiescent stage
labels.function: Final phase: minimal cellular activity remains

labels.name: Mosaic pattern
accept: mosaic pattern of woven and lamellar bone
labels.function: Biopsy finding from chaotic remodeling

labels.name: Osteoclast
labels.function: Multinucleated resorbing cell; bisphosphonates inhibit it

labels.name: Osteoblast
labels.function: Bone-forming cell; high turnover raises bone ALP
